page.layout: One page of text in a single column, with no margin notes. A decorative woodcut banner sits above the title. Heading block: "INDEX TRACTATUUM, LIBRORUM, ET CAPITUM." Below it, a list of two italic lines. Then "LIBER PRIMUS." with a subtitle, "CAP. I.", and an italic chapter summary set as a block paragraph. No running head, page number, catchword or signature.

l.i: Epistola ad Anglicorum Seminariorum alumnos Romæ & Rhemis.
Præfatio in libros de Romanæ Ecclesiæ idolo-lolatria.

p.i: Ecclesiam Romanam idololatriæ in cultu Sanctorum, reliquiarum, & imaginum. à Luthero, Melanchthone, Magdebur-gensibus, Calvino, aliisque Protestanti-bus, non per calumnias & mendacia, ut Bellarminus falsò asserit, sed verè & merito accusari.

page.notes: No marginal notes. The top banner is a printer's woodcut ornament, not text. "Ecclesiæ" and similar words are set with long s, transcribed as plain s. Line-end hyphens in "TRACTA-", "idolo-", "Magdebur-" and "Protestanti-" are kept as printed. The chapter summary is set in italic as one block, and I have transcribed it as a paragraph rather than a heading.
